I am processing this request to install the TIA version 3.5.47, to solve the converter grouping configuration. The request is to install the fix on the whole fleet in Finland, however I noticed that:
51 chargers are already on v5.0.21

additional_info.subject: RE: 0382148 - ID0382148-DC/Si-D/FI-[Fleet] - Converter group toggling CRM:00314000124
additional_info.body:
Hi Fosco,
Unfortunately, I am not going to update more charger anymore due to issues with 5.0.21. All charger that are running now 5.0.21 will stay in current FW but for the rest I am waiting version 6.x.x if that improve stability versus 5.0.21.
My experience now is that the newest version is more unstable than previously version and we have now 2 charger that never came online after updating it to 5.0.21. COAP polling error is now more common / worse, 3 / 4 sockets in some locations goes suddenly OoO (COAP?) and then this converter issue.
I am asking you to install the fix for current fleet of 5.0.21
😊
BR,
Markus
